purpose: Prevent future deterministic or generative producers from confusing logical placement dimensions with native output raster dimensions.

outputProfile.targetDpi: quality/use profile selected independently from composition

rule: Derived target pixels may be transported and hashed, but must not become an independent competing authority that can disagree with physical holder + output profile.

h45WideExample.instructionShape: Compose for the 22:9 wide placement, but return a native master at or above the print-use raster requirement; do not treat 440x180 as the requested native file size.

fixedOutputProducerFallback: select a producer output size large enough that the final safe crop meets both required pixel dimensions
preserve the target aspect using safe neutral canvas/crop rather than stretching product geometry
record the actual returned raster separately from the requested physical-use requirement
reject an apparently sharp large output if identity/factual review fails
scopeNotes: This does not modify the historical predeclared H45 Class C trial; that experiment remains immutable evidence of the tested producer-contract failure.
A future viewpoint-change experiment requires its own predeclared fidelity invariants and is not authorized merely by this resolution contract.
Table/Card/Collection can have different required raster dimensions for the same product because physical usage differs.
